attributes.value: Forest River's first Class B line, introduced for 2027 alongside the ProMaster-based Sommar. Shared feature set in the release: 2,800-watt flex-fuel generator, dual 12-volt house batteries, 170 watts of solar, 1,000-watt inverter, Timberline heat and water system, fiberglass wet bath.
